༄༅/ /gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhugs/rin chen shog 'dra/

tei:div.tei:p: rin chen shog 'dra/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i sprin 'khrigs shing*/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs pa'i/ /bla ma kun la gsol ba 'debs/ /ci bsam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i pho brang du/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /kun bzang yab yum gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhi thog grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bde chen 'og min pho brang du/ /rigs lnga bde gsha ེ gas rdo rje 'chang*/ /rdo rje sems dpar gsol ba 'debs/ /lhun grub rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang du/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjai'i sprin tshogs can/ /dga' rab rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi pho brang du/ /ye shes lnga lngar 'gro ba'i yab/ /shrī sidhar gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /so sa gling gi pho brang du/ /mchog dang thung mong dngos grub brnyes/ /pad+ma thod phreng gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsum 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /o rgyan yul gyi pho brang du/ /mkha' 'gro dpag med kun gyi gtso/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang byung ye shes pho brang du/ /snying po'i don rtogs byin rlabs ldan/ /dri med 'od zer gsol ba 'debs/ /'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos sdings dpal gyi pho brang du/ /theg mchog chos 'khor kun gyi bdag /chos kyi grags par gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /grog ri o rgyan yang dben du/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /nyi ma 'od zer gsol ba 'debs/ /dgos 'dod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dkar po chos lung dgon pa ru/ /rdo rje snying po'i dngos grub brnyes/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs/ /kun bzang gling gi pho brang du/

/zab don rgya mtsho'i bstan pa 'di/ /chos dby-ings grags par gsol ba 'debs/ / thams cad mkhyen par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ / smin grol mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /sku lnga lhun grub byin gyis rlobs/ khra mo brag gi pho brang du/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i mchog /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsol ba 'debs/ /lhag med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /las can 'du ba'i pho brang du/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med/ /gter srung rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang du/ /bslab gsum sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /chos mdzad yongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan pa gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lus lha yi pho brang du/ /stong gsal ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /zhi khro rab 'byams gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /grags stong gsum gi pho brang du/ /rtsa gnas yi ge'i 'khor lo nyid/ /rang byung ye nas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshangs dbyangs thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems nyid don gyi pho brang du/ /thams cad ma skyes mnyam pa nyid/ /rig stong chos skur gsol ba 'debs/ /rang shar rang grol byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid snod bcud pho brang du/ /thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas zhing*/ /srid gsum yongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mnyam nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' grol klong yangs pho brang du/ /mtha' bral gnyis med nam mkha'i don/ /lta ba mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs lhung med par byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal don gyi pho brang du/ /gsal stong gnyis med gnyug ma'i don/ /sgom pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsal 'grib med par byin gyis rlobs/ / blang dor med pa'i pho brang du/ /thams cad ye shes sgyu ma'i ngang*/ /spyod pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/

/gnyis 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /re dogs med pa'i pho brang du/ /rang rig 'od gsal 'pho 'gyur med/ /'bras bu mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*/ /mchod 'os rnams la dus kun tu/ /snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /'phrin las 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa dang*/ /nges 'byung skyo shas skye ba dang*/ /nyin mtshan chos kyi 'da' ba dang*/ /blo sna thung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid bla mar rtogs pa dang*/ /byin rlabs rgyun chad med pa dang*/ /dag snang phyogs med 'char ba dang*/ /mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag tu dben par gnas pa dang*/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med pa dang*/ /dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa dang*/ /lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di chos kyi 'da' ba dang*/ /rtag tu bla ma mnyes pa dang*/ /sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa dang*/ /gzhan don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /las dang nyon mongs zad pa dang*/ /byang chub lam la brtson pa dang*/ /sa dang lam rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir 'od lus 'grub pa dang*/ /bar do rang ngo shes pa dang*/ /rang bzhin sprul par skye ba dang*/ /don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi/ /dge bas srid pa'i sems can kun/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rab brgal te/ /phyam cig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i dus su sbyar ba dge'o/ /dri med 'od zer gyi rjes kyi sh+lau ka lnga kha skong yin pa 'dra'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
